# garage_keys (Data Source)

Lists every access key of the cluster, without secrets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "garage_keys" "all" {}

output "expired_keys" {
  value = [for k in data.garage_keys.all.keys : k.name if k.expired]
}
```
